about: Every third-party asset and library used by the app, where it came from, and its license. Shown on the in-app Credits screen and in CREDITS.md. Update this file whenever something is added.

sources.notes: Built with tool/build_usda_foods.py. USDA asks to be credited as the source.

sources.title: Open Food Facts (online lookups, not bundled)
sources.author: Open Food Facts contributors
sources.attribution: Product data from Open Food Facts (openfoodfacts.org), ODbL.
sources.notes: Read-only API. Rate limits: 15 product reads/min, 10 searches/min per IP. Search runs only on submit, never as-you-type.

sources.notes: 69 exercise subset, built with tool/build_exercises.py. MET values added from the Compendium of Physical Activities (estimates).
